---
title: "YouTube Category Insights Dashboard"
output:
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: rows
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Load required libraries
library(flexdashboard)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
library(ggridges)
library(treemapify)

# Set the working directory for knitting
knitr::opts_knit$set(
  root.dir = "/Users/venkatasrideepthisrikotapeetamabaram/R Studio Projects"
)

# Read the dataset
video_stats <- read.delim(
  "videos-stats.csv",
  sep = ",",
  strip.white = TRUE
)

# Data Cleaning
video_stats <- video_stats %>%
  drop_na()

# Feature Engineering
video_stats <- video_stats %>%
  mutate(
    LikesPer1k = round(Likes / (Views / 1000), 2),
    CommentsPer1k = round(Comments / (Views / 1000), 2),
    TitleLen = nchar(Title),
    PubYear = as.factor(substr(Published.At, 1, 4)),
    Published.At = as.POSIXct(
      Published.At,
      format = "%Y-%m-%d"
    )
  )
```
Row
-------------------------------------

### Top Categories by Total Views

```{r}
video_stats %>%
  group_by(Keyword) %>%
  summarise(
    TotalViews = sum(Views)/1000000,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(TotalViews)) %>%
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = reorder(Keyword, TotalViews),
      y = TotalViews,
      fill = Keyword
    )
  ) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Top Categories by Total Views",
    x = "Category",
    y = "Views (Millions)"
  )
```


Row
-------------------------------------

### Title Length by Category

```{r}
video_stats %>%
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = Keyword,
      y = TitleLen,
      fill = Keyword
    )
  ) +
  geom_boxplot(show.legend = FALSE) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Title Length by Category",
    x = "Category",
    y = "Title Length"
  )
```

### Ridgeline Plot of Title Length

```{r}
ggplot(
  video_stats,
  aes(
    x = TitleLen,
    y = PubYear,
    fill = PubYear
  )
) +
  geom_density_ridges(
    alpha = 0.7,
    scale = 2
  ) +
  theme_ridges() +
  labs(
    title = "Title Length Distribution Across Years",
    x = "Title Length",
    y = "Publication Year"
  )
```
Row
-------------------------------------

### Number of Videos by Category

```{r}
video_stats %>%
  count(Keyword) %>%
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = reorder(Keyword, n),
      y = n,
      fill = Keyword
    )
  ) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Videos Published per Category",
    x = "Category",
    y = "Number of Videos"
  )
```

### Average Title Length by Category

```{r}
video_stats %>%
  group_by(Keyword) %>%
  summarise(
    AvgTitle = mean(TitleLen),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = reorder(Keyword, AvgTitle),
      y = AvgTitle,
      fill = Keyword
    )
  ) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Average Title Length by Category",
    x = "Category",
    y = "Average Characters"
  )
```
